content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments represents a paradigm shift for digital creators. By utilizing infrastructure that operates independently of conventional payment platforms, creators can retain full control over their sales processes. This method not only reduces dependency on services like Gumroad, which charges high fees on sales but also circumvents the limitations imposed by financial infrastructure in various regions. Embracing this approach means embracing sovereignty over your commerce activities.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling design assets with crypto payments is built on a combination of free and low-cost tools that ensure seamless operation. For hosting, platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are utilized, while backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which allows creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a mere 0.5% transaction fee. This structure empowers creators to automate product delivery and maintain full data ownership, creating a robust digital storefront.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where traditional payment systems are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Whether you're an ebook author in Zimbabwe, a course creator in Kenya, or a graphic designer in Ghana, this solution offers a way to effectively monetize your work. By adopting crypto payments, you not only enhance your revenue potential but also position yourself as a pioneer in the evolving landscape of digital commerce.
Gumroad's fees can eat into your profits; NOWPayments ensures you keep more of what you earn.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful implementation of this architecture hinges on several key components. First, the hosting solution—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—provides a reliable platform for your website. Next, backend services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script enable the logic for processing orders. Order storage is facilitated by tools like Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery is managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, NOWPayments integrates cryptocurrency payment processing, ensuring you can accept payments without the overhead of platform fees.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by selecting your preferred hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing. Choose a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets to track orders and use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. By following these steps, you can create a fully operational online store that circumvents traditional payment barriers.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Take control of your sales infrastructure and avoid reliance on platforms that restrict access.

If you're looking to sell design assets like ebooks or templates without relying on traditional platforms, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This comprehensive package includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook by utilizing a sovereign commerce stack. Use GitHub Pages for hosting, and integrate NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency. This setup avoids reliance on traditional payment systems altogether.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to use a combination of free tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for accepting crypto payments. This minimizes fees significantly compared to platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by setting up your own digital store using infrastructure tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts independently of platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins such as USDT, providing you with flexibility in payment options.
How much will I save on fees using this infrastructure?
Using NOWPayments, you only pay a 0.5% fee per transaction, compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. For 100 sales of a $97 product, this saves you $921 in fees.
